import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine().trim());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int m = n * (n - 1) / 2;

        int[][][] dp = new int[n + 1][m + 1][n + 1];
        dp[1][0][1] = 1 % mod;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                    int a = dp[i][j][k];
                    if (a == 0) continue;

                    // dp[i+1][j+i][i+1] += a
                    dp[i + 1][j + i][i + 1] = (int)((dp[i + 1][j + i][i + 1] + (long)a) % mod);

                    for (int l = 0; l < i; l++) {
                        dp[i + 1][j + i - 1 - l][k] = (int)((dp[i + 1][j + i - 1 - l][k] + (long)a) % mod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // S_dp[i][k][j] = cumulative sum over j of dp[i][j][k] modulo mod
        long[][][] S_dp = new long[n + 1][n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    sum += dp[i][j][k];
                    sum %= mod;
                    S_dp[i][k][j] = sum;
                }
            }
        }

        // SS_dp[i][j][k] = cumulative sum over k of S_dp[i][k][j] modulo mod
        long[][][] SS_dp = new long[n + 1][m + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                    sum += S_dp[i][k][j];
                    sum %= mod;
                    SS_dp[i][j][k] = sum;
                }
            }
        }

        long[] ANS = new long[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long ans = (i * ANS[i - 1]) % mod;
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                    if (dp[i][j][k] == 0) continue;
                    long diff = SS_dp[i][j - 1][n] - SS_dp[i][j - 1][k];
                    diff %= mod;
                    if (diff < 0) diff += mod;
                    ans = (ans + (long)dp[i][j][k] * diff) % mod;
                }
            }
            ANS[i] = ans;
        }

        System.out.println(ANS[n]);
    }
}
